status: editorial review; not a formal gate verdict

records.title: Separate information diversity from model diversity
records.strength: The design already matches the fact union and separates model family from evidence access.
records.concern: Capability matching on a calibration average can leave large difficulty-specific differences; a mixed team can win because its strongest member solves one rare stratum.
records.revision: Report member-alone outcomes on the same held-out strata and compare team improvement over the best prespecified member, without selecting that member on test results.
records.decision_rule: Retain a diversity mechanism claim only if a residual benefit survives this comparison; otherwise report capability allocation.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Ablate why semantic routing works
records.strength: Router calls and degree-matched random delivery are already budgeted.
records.concern: A need-matching router can receive a cleaner task representation than the workers, making routing an extra solver.
records.revision: Freeze and publish the router observation contract; compare a simple indexed lookup given the same representation and measure required-fact delivery separately from integration.
records.decision_rule: If lookup matches utility and cost, reuse lookup and drop the semantic-router complexity.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Stop on evidence sufficiency instead of verbal agreement
records.strength: The public checklist schema is available to every arm.
records.concern: Complete fields need not be sufficient for a correct inference; duplicate, stale or incompatible values can satisfy a syntactic checklist.
records.revision: Add complete-but-inconsistent and incomplete-but-decision-sufficient worlds; score useful justified abstention separately from checklist completion.
records.decision_rule: Reject the stopping rule if lower apparent error is purchased by routinely refusing solvable tasks.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Evidence-seeking critics versus generic opposition
records.strength: The candidate includes an equally funded independent solver baseline.
records.concern: An evidence-seeking critic can win because it gets a second observation, rather than because opposition helps.
records.revision: Cross new evidence access with reviewer role; give an ordinary verifier the same retrieval opportunities and compare correct-to-wrong as well as wrong-to-correct changes.
records.decision_rule: If role wording adds no value after access matching, describe the result as verification, not beneficial dissent.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Test dissent quality rather than dissent quantity
records.strength: Correctness, confidence and inspectable observations are crossed explicitly.
records.concern: A scripted correct critic with an unusually transparent witness tests recipient response under favorable evidence, not whether a swarm produces good critics.
records.revision: Keep the scripted study, then separately qualify evidence generation with noisy critics; counterbalance whether correct and wrong reports are easier to check.
records.decision_rule: Do not generalize to autonomous dissent until critic generation earns its cost on held-out tasks.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Rotate coordination without losing continuity
records.strength: Outages, ledger capacity and surviving worker count are controlled.
records.concern: Rotation can primarily improve externalization discipline; replacing a leader without the same handoff format is a weak baseline.
records.revision: Give the fixed leader the identical periodic handoff requirement and ledger; compare outage recovery and clean-task overhead.
records.decision_rule: If ledger discipline explains the gain, recommend it without rotation.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Compress memory by information value
records.strength: Retention policies share capacity and pay selection costs.
records.concern: Information value depends on the future task distribution; a curated rare-fact fixture can make the favored selector look prescient.
records.revision: Freeze a mixture of recurring, rare-useful and rare-useless facts on development worlds; shift their frequencies and score calibration of retention value.
records.decision_rule: If value estimation loses to recency after cost or shift, restrict it to the calibrated workload.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Recover function after genuine knowledge loss
records.strength: Unavailable evidence and hidden backups are explicitly distinguished.
records.concern: A failure to recover destroyed information is an identifiability limit, not necessarily a poor repair policy.
records.revision: Label recoverable, inferable and nonidentifiable losses separately; require the latter to produce calibrated uncertainty rather than a fabricated restoration.
records.decision_rule: Do not score honest uncertainty as failed regeneration when the answer is unavailable to every allowed method.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: What survives complete population turnover?
records.strength: Arbitrary conventions are counterbalanced and worlds outlive their founding agents.
records.concern: A preserved string in a shared prompt can satisfy persistence without demonstrating adaptive cultural transmission.
records.revision: Separate literal copying from transfer of a useful procedure; perturb wording and task instances while preserving the functional rule.
records.decision_rule: Call literal persistence a memory baseline; retain a functional-transmission claim only if behavior transfers.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Retire an obsolete convention after the task changes
records.strength: Unchanged worlds measure the cost of needless revision.
records.concern: The fixed change time can become a schedule cue, and an outcome review can receive effectively explicit instructions.
records.revision: Hide and randomize change time within a declared range; include noisy outcomes without a regime change and record evidence used to abandon the rule.
records.decision_rule: Drop adaptation claims if behavior follows the clock or a telltale feedback phrase.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Credit verified contributions instead of message volume
records.strength: Maintenance work and independent artifact utility are included.
records.concern: LLM responses to a reward description do not by themselves establish incentive compatibility or spontaneous cooperation.
records.revision: Distinguish prompted role compliance from a policy trained or selected by actual rewards; include unverifiable and maintenance contributions in a frozen utility ledger.
records.decision_rule: Use bounded behavioral language; abandon a welfare claim if credited output rises while total utility falls.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Make a report lead to a verifiable response
records.strength: Noticing, reporting, review and correction are separate stages.
records.concern: A dedicated responder increases guaranteed service; the apparent institution effect may be queue priority rather than report structure.
records.revision: Compare structured and unstructured reports with the same queue service, deadline and reviewer budget; include noisy high-volume reporting.
records.decision_rule: If reliable service alone explains the gain, implement the queue rather than a larger governance mechanism.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Appeal false rejections without overwhelming review
records.strength: The equally funded second review is a strong baseline.
records.concern: Appeal selection can concentrate on easy-to-overturn cases, while an honest silent contributor has no comparable access.
records.revision: Keep episode-level assignment and report outcomes for all first-pass rejections; add a randomly assigned automatic second-review condition with the same service budget.
records.decision_rule: Reject the appeal mechanism if it only redistributes reviewer access or preferentially rehabilitates invalid work.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Find where uncertainty disappears in retelling
records.strength: The design scores atomic claims and counts chains as units.
records.concern: A short structured schema may preserve a few fields by deleting scope qualifiers that determine whether a claim applies.
records.revision: Freeze indispensable qualifiers and source-conditioned truth before formatting; score coverage and fidelity jointly with equal token budgets.
records.decision_rule: A low error rate obtained by omitting difficult claims is not successful transmission.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Stress-test a casefile when logs are missing
records.strength: The candidate already distinguishes missing records from hidden intentions.
records.concern: Evaluator-complete logs still do not identify every cause: two mechanisms can generate the same visible trace.
records.revision: Construct observationally equivalent traces with different hidden causes; reward an explicit set of compatible explanations and penalize confident identification.
records.decision_rule: Keep the casefile if it improves supported decisions; drop claims of causal reconstruction from logs alone.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Select complementary teams on a separate task set
records.strength: Selection cost, task-family holdout and overlapping-team dependence are already addressed.
records.concern: The number of searched team subsets can create a calibration winner even without useful complementarity.
records.revision: Freeze the search budget; compare equally searched accuracy-only and complementarity selectors and retain an untouched final set of task families.
records.decision_rule: If the gain vanishes with equal search or cost amortization, keep the default team.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Count evidence domains rather than returning copies
records.strength: Unknown ancestry and source-oracle ceilings are explicit.
records.concern: Observed source grouping can merge independent correct observations or split copies; either error can reverse the intended weighting.
records.revision: Cross false merges and false splits independently of marginal source quality, including an honest singleton with decisive evidence.
records.decision_rule: Do not call source concentration independent sample size unless it predicts held-out error under those perturbations.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Repair when the dependency graph is wrong
records.strength: The design already compares incomplete graphs, reset and append-only correction.
records.concern: Random edge deletion may be much easier than systematic missing lineage at the particular path needed for a sensitive action.
records.revision: Add clustered omissions at summaries and action boundaries, and faithful existing strict/fail-closed baselines; price revalidation and false blocking.
records.decision_rule: Limit the claim to the tested missingness mechanism if selective repair fails on concentrated omissions.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Stale children can undo a correction
records.strength: Useful unaffected late reports protect against reject-all being an unfair straw baseline.
records.concern: Epoch checks protect a record only while its semantic content remains associated with the old epoch; a rewritten retry may look current.
records.revision: Add rephrased and freshly reissued stale claims, plus genuinely valid reversals; preserve observable metadata rather than evaluator ancestry.
records.decision_rule: If protection covers only verbatim stale records, report version filtering, not general recurrence prevention.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: When can an isolated child safely return?
records.strength: Held-out checks, false quarantine and review costs are acknowledged.
records.concern: Passing a finite release test cannot establish trust in a still-adversarial controller; the observation window may be too short for relapse.
records.revision: Separate affected honest instances, replaced instances and continuously adversarial instances; fix horizon and censoring and evaluate restricted capabilities directly.
records.decision_rule: Claim bounded risk reduction only; do not label a passed check proof of alignment.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: A detector that isolates nodes changes the evidence
records.strength: The plan randomizes whole communities and includes random isolation.
records.concern: A utility-aware policy may be given better knowledge of which node owns unique evidence than the static detector.
records.revision: Equalize policy-visible expertise metadata; randomize expertise assignment independently of suspicious appearance and charge reacquisition.
records.decision_rule: If oracle expertise access explains the ranking, reject the deployable utility-aware advantage.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Keep enough budget to finish and verify
records.strength: The reserve is deducted from production and low-value validation tasks are included.
records.concern: A favorable fixed reserve can encode advance knowledge of the task length or final verification cost.
records.revision: Shift the distribution of completion costs after tuning; compare a simple deadline rule and show completed utility across the full resource frontier.
records.decision_rule: Use a reserve only where it beats simple scheduling under plausible cost uncertainty.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Can the benchmark be solved without observing peers?
records.strength: Blind policies are qualified from the start instead of only masking a trained policy.
records.concern: Failure of one weak blind policy is not evidence that peer observation is necessary; target leakage may remain in timing or labels.
records.revision: Use several competent open-loop and metadata-only policies and adversarially permute schedules and labels before full agent runs.
records.decision_rule: A blind shortcut falsifies the intended benchmark claim; failure to find one is a qualified audit result, not a proof.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Neural cellular repair beyond familiar lesion shapes
records.strength: Weights are frozen, sham damage is included and puzzles are the independent units.
records.concern: A chosen reasoning front can be a larger information lesion despite matched area or norm; pretrained checkpoint access and lesion provenance remain practical dependencies.
records.revision: Define the front without seeing recovery; compare matched channel/location lesions and new puzzle families, scoring valid solutions rather than attractive regrowth.
records.decision_rule: Defer if checkpoint and lesion controls cannot be audited in time; otherwise call it a bounded robustness comparison.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Root identity at the observation level
records.strength: It separates site identity from observation ancestry.
records.concern: The distinction is already central to SEC-03; a separate headline risks counting the same experiment twice.
records.revision: Make granularity and false grouping the SEC-03 ablation; retain this ID as a traceable implementation question.
records.decision_rule: Keep a separate study only if it adds a distinct outcome or acquisition intervention.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Reachability of a correct commit
records.strength: This is correctly framed as a specification test.
records.concern: The current Scheme C ceiling is below one for finite positive parameters, so unanimous correct votes cannot commit even when the configuration feasibility check passes.
records.revision: Enumerate empty, tied, unanimous and increasing-evidence states before model runs; separate admission from stopping.
records.decision_rule: Block use of the current rule until a declared correct unanimous state can commit or an explicit justified abstention policy replaces the intended behavior.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: The detector changes the swarm it observes
records.strength: It treats probes as interventions.
records.concern: Passive-versus-active comparison also changes acquired information; the existing SEC-50 policy study already covers a neighboring feedback effect.
records.revision: Keep a probe-induced shift subexperiment with equal observation budgets, randomized probe timing and clean utility costs.
records.decision_rule: Merge with the detector-policy work unless the probe contrast changes a separate deployment decision.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Budget exhaustion changes the causal estimand
records.strength: It treats unfinished episodes as outcomes instead of deleting them.
records.concern: Different provider throttling windows can still confound arms even when every outcome is reported.
records.revision: Randomize blocked execution order, separate logical budgets from infrastructure failures and retain all-assigned operational utility plus a clearly secondary reasoning-only analysis.
records.decision_rule: Do not rank agent intelligence from resource-contaminated completion rates alone.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Track conclusions that depend on something being absent
records.strength: Negative dependencies and completeness witnesses are explicit.
records.concern: If absence is simply encoded as a positive versioned fact, the proposed repair may already be ordinary dependency invalidation.
records.revision: Compare explicit absence certificates against that materialized-positive baseline; include certificate expiry and incomplete search domains.
records.decision_rule: If they behave identically, reuse the existing representation rather than claim a new repair mechanism.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Give an omission detector a bounded completeness contract
records.strength: The original full record is labeled an oracle.
records.concern: A signed count proves neither that records are distinct nor that they contain the required categories.
records.revision: Add same-count substitution, duplicate records and stale manifests; compare counts against category/version manifests at equal verification cost.
records.decision_rule: Recommend only the weakest manifest that supports justified decisions; counts alone must not certify completeness.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Protect a rare view without rewarding a wrong view
records.strength: Preserving a minority report is distinguished from adopting its conclusion.
records.concern: It overlaps SOC-10 and can mistake accessible stored dissent for evidence actually used by a later decision.
records.revision: Fold it into the dissent factorial with a delayed task that specifically needs the retained evidence; compare against ordinary searchable storage.
records.decision_rule: Keep retention only if it improves later justified decisions at matched memory cost.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Abstain from selecting a team when profiling is inconclusive
records.strength: The proposal permits falling back to a default and prices profiling.
records.concern: The abstention threshold can be tuned to whichever task distribution makes the default look good.
records.revision: Freeze the default and threshold before evaluation; show cold-start and long-horizon costs and unexpected difficulty shifts.
records.decision_rule: If no horizon relevant to this project pays back profiling, stop selecting teams.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Can separately valid edits violate a joint invariant?
records.strength: Joint invariant violations offer deterministic ground truth.
records.concern: Write skew is an established transaction problem; showing that an atomic validator prevents it is engineering conformance rather than a new swarm mechanism.
records.revision: First test the conventional transaction baseline; then ask whether agents can identify a previously unstated cross-edit invariant under equal information.
records.decision_rule: If the invariant is fully supplied and host-enforced, ship the safeguard but avoid a research novelty claim.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Do retries duplicate a valid action?
records.strength: Lost acknowledgments isolate a clear duplicate-action failure.
records.concern: Operation-level deduplication can win by construction when the harness supplies perfect identity; the difficult part is choosing identity across legitimate repeats.
records.revision: Cross retries with intentional identical operations and scope/expiry changes; separate host-generated operation IDs from agent-inferred IDs.
records.decision_rule: Treat perfect-ID success as a regression test; retain a research question only for the ambiguous identity boundary.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Can shared memory keep two tasks’ truths separate?
records.strength: Same names with different task truths expose cross-task contamination.
records.concern: Namespaces can appear sufficient because task ownership is unambiguous; blanket isolation may also block legitimately shared facts.
records.revision: Cross ambiguous task assignment with common reusable knowledge and revocations; compare strict isolation, explicit sharing and selective retrieval under the same memory cap.
records.decision_rule: Use simple namespaces if selective sharing adds risk without task benefit.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Can a defender distinguish flaky tools from targeted interference?
records.strength: The question explicitly includes observationally indistinguishable conditions.
records.concern: Caller-dependent failures can result from benign routing or quotas; a useful diagnostic pattern is not evidence of malicious intent.
records.revision: Label the outcome actionable service behavior; preregister indistinguishable pairs and compare abstention and fallback utility, not hidden-motive accuracy.
records.decision_rule: Drop malicious-versus-aligned labels when the permitted observations cannot distinguish their causes.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference from the cited context and inspected proposal; not an empirical finding.

records.title: Immune-response experimental design
records.strength: Stage A explicitly identifies an oracle mechanism study and keeps later realistic detection separate.
records.concern: The oracle confirms affected agents and restores checkpoints; a positive result cannot support deployable selective repair. Eight actors over long schedules also risk spending most of the hackathon on plumbing.
records.revision: Implement the private/shared reservoir factorial on a minimal symbolic world first. Preserve a clean-utility and correct-specialist control before promoting the claim; price information lost by rollback.
records.decision_rule: Proceed to model qualification only after a reachable recurrence case and a cheaper correction-only comparator are validated. Do not present Stage A as the full immune system.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference and direct inspection of this design; no independent runtime or model experiment.

records.title: External-influence / Scheme C design
records.strength: The bundle makes external exposure, imperfect provenance and resource costs explicit.
records.concern: The unanimous-commit counterexample persists in the inspected rule. The sample arithmetic states clustering assumptions, but a design effect alone does not specify a valid clustered paired test.
records.revision: Resolve the state-machine defect first. Choose one observed-provenance comparison and define world-level paired inference and a fixed primary endpoint before using pilot variance for sizing.
records.decision_rule: Do not launch the full sweep with the current commit band, or describe an assumed 20-point effect calculation as demonstrated precision.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference and direct inspection of this design; no independent runtime or model experiment.

records.title: Discussion-dose environment
records.strength: All-assigned outcomes, private probes and scripted-versus-LLM separation are unusually explicit.
records.concern: The discussion-dose contrast changes computation and exposure as well as discussion. Canonical audit documents and one altered numeric field make verification favorable; clean scripted success is not model qualification.
records.revision: Keep the planned dose effect as a total-resource effect; add equal-budget private deliberation only if claiming a social mechanism. Independently inspect hard and easy rendered worlds, and use a distinct task rule for transfer.
records.decision_rule: Retain the small qualification study, but do not infer persuasion, novel routing, or general agent security from its engineered source hierarchy.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference and direct inspection of this design; no independent runtime or model experiment.

records.title: Distributed-evidence suite plan
records.strength: The plan states that full-information A/B and evidence-discovery C/D estimate different effects.
records.concern: The shared engine can make four studies seem like one corroborating body of evidence; they share templates, scoring assumptions and selected model qualification.
records.revision: Implement Study A first with an independently scored fixture; preregister each later estimand separately and preserve a second rule family not used in choosing prompts or model.
records.decision_rule: If the full-information single solver solves the fixture cheaply, justify what operational constraint makes the team useful before enlarging the suite.
records.evidence_basis: Reviewer inference and direct inspection of this design; no independent runtime or model experiment.
